text:
alex: Heads-up — proposing header precedence for routing: `x-route-hint-v2` > `x-customer-assertion` (signed) > user-agent heuristic. Plan: console opt-in toggle for 2-week canary. Thoughts?

maria: Quick q — how do we attribute quotas/usage? if we accept unsigned headers we could get spoofed attribution.

chris: We should require a signed assertion for quota & ownership. e.g. `x-customer-assertion` as a compact JWT signed by customer key (ed25519). If missing, allow UA fallback for routing but do NOT apply quota changes.

jen: Backwards compatibility: we still have existing `x-route-hint`. Will `x-route-hint-v2` take precedence if present? and what about proxies that strip weird hdrs?

alex: Yes `x-route-hint-v2` wins. Fallback chain: 1) v2 signed assertion 2) v2 raw hint 3) old `x-route-hint` 4) UA heuristic. Proxies: we'll document recommended preservation and add `x-preserve-headers` option in ingress.

alex: Proposed minimal route config (for the gateway):
```yaml
routes:
  - match:
      header_equals:
        x-route-hint-v2: "billing"
    action:
      route_to: "dedicated-billing"
      enforce_quota: false
    telemetry_labels:
      routing_hint: "raw"
  - match:
      header_verified_assertion:
        claim: tenant_id
    action:
      route_to: "tenant-pool"
      enforce_quota: true
    telemetry_labels:
      routing_hint: "signed"
```

infra-bot: Notice: canary job queued by @alex — /canary start will run against 5% of traffic for 72h. Use `--tag routing-hint-v2` to filter. :package:

sam: Performance note — parsing/verifying signed assertions adds CPU. Can we do sampling for full signature verification? e.g. verify 100% for quota-relevant requests, 1% for telemetry traces. Also prefer compact signatures to minimize parsing overhead.

maria: Console UX: add tenant-level toggle "Honor x-route-hint-v2" + an explanations pane, and surface a telemetry column showing `routing_hint` and `hint_verified`. That'll help customers debug misroutes.

chris: For quota enforcement: I propose gateway extracts `tenant_id` from verified assertion and uses `tenant:<id>` as quota key. If no verified assertion, fallback to `api_key` or deny quota-sensitive ops.

alex: Agreed. Flow: gateway verifies signature -> extracts tenant_id -> maps to quota key -> route + enforce. If verification fails, route but mark `hint_verified:false` and do not grant quota. UA-only routes get `hint=ua` and `enforce_quota=false` by default.

jen: What's the assertion schema? need compact, aud/exp, signer metadata. Sample: 
```json
{"iss":"customer:acme","sub":"routing-assertion","tenant_id":"acme:123","exp":1710000000,"sig":"..."}
```
(we'll use JWS compact in prod)

sam: Add metrics: `routing_hint` labels: [signed, raw, old_hdr, ua, missing], and `hint_verified` boolean. Also add a histogram for header-parse latency. Sample 1% for full trace.

maria: LGTM. Also add runbook steps: 1) detect spike in `hint_verified:false` 2) alert on `route_mismatch_rate > 0.5%` 3) rollback toggle for tenants.

alex: Thanks all — I'll open the PR with gateway changes + console flag. Plan canary next Wed. @infra-bot please schedule the canary. :calendar:

infra-bot: Canary scheduled for 2023-11-08 02:00 UTC against 5% traffic, tag `routing-hint-v2`. CI: green. :white_check_mark:

maria: One last ask — add telemetry that surfaces upstream proxy losses (header-stripped) so we can correlate new misroutes with ingress changes.

alex: Good call. We'll include a `header_integrity` tag (ok|stripped|unknown) and log a sample of requests where header_integrity!=ok.

chris: +1. Ready to review the PR when it's up.

jen: Thanks — I'll draft tenant communication blurb for the console toggle release notes. :memo:
